label: Septu system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Septu locus encoding PtuA and the HNH endonuclease PtuB, whose PtuAB oligomer confers antiphage immunity through nuclease-mediated phage genome cleavage in standalone systems and can be regulated by retron RT-msDNA complexes in Retron-Septu loci.
observations: Septu branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual ptuA or ptuB genes, PtuA or PtuB proteins, PtuAB complex assembly, HNH nuclease activity, retron RT-msDNA regulation, source database rows naming one Septu locus, Retron-Septu subtypes, and other antiphage systems such as BREX, DISARM, CBASS, Gabija, Hachiman, Shedu, Thoeris, Zorya, Kiwa, Lamassu, phosphorothioate defense, CRISPR-Cas, and abortive infection families.
